source.styleReference: 参考/云山巨城·未来家居资产图鉴.png
source.features: 昆虫六足髋膝、四翅根、头和腹部局部刚性动作
source.limitations: M043技术候选：连续曲面、翼、斜带及骨链，不强制整件卡格。昆虫最小细件1mm，其余5mm原生。全部非碰撞、未绑定电源零发光。骨架保留真实父子关节与刚性分件、归属和有限姿态，不冒称软皮肤、动作片段、原骨架重定向、飞行游泳/步态/生态/所有权集成。穿戴仅指定猫犬牛有限静态配合；空牌不捏造身份，人工美术验收0。

detail.anatomy: Six independently formed legs, head/thorax/abdomen, paired antennae, distinct compound eyes and four thin closed wings with actual vein solids. Minimum native details use 1mm pitch. Butterfly patterns are continuous thin scale layers, not voxel staircases.
detail.motion: Actual wing, six hip/knee, head and abdomen local rigid joints; finite flexion study only, no animation clips or flight simulation.

source.dimensionBasis: Author anatomy/family guide or finite accessory fit, not original runtime dimensions

materialAssignmentReview.note: Rig guides use tooling purposes; insect tissue and wing scales/membranes/veins, bird plumage, and worn hardware/webbing/ink remain independently replaceable. Coarse skin/hair categories do not equate their physical tissues.

source.现有证据: 开发备忘录.md:322；docs/需求实现验证矩阵.md:56；src/types.ts:33,48（有biodiversity数值，无动物实体/外观契约）；src/renderer.ts:829-832（只消费居民、货品、车辆）
source.生产方式: 动物母版统一手工骨骼与挂点；Tripo绑定仅候选
source.依赖接口: 拟动物实体id/species/owner/position/age/state + 可见区池接口；当前types.ts无该契约，资产不假造生态或库存
source.派生规则: 按体态族复用重定向，爪/翼/尾关节规格明确，不一物种一套冗余骨架
source.验收要求: 绑定无塌体，脚/翼/尾符合物种；无GPU/长期模拟核验，交付需离线资产与真实实体驱动验收

CHAR-327.note: 已有可编辑几何候选；尺寸为制作默认值。尚未通过人工美术、游戏功能点、LOD 或动画验收。
